name: exclusively-me
description: Build and update a link-in-bio page: one page that holds all your links, at your own address.

interface.longDescription:
Exclusively Me builds and updates link-in-bio pages: one page, at your own address (exclusively.me/yourname), that holds all your links in one place: Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, your website and more.

Tell ChatGPT your name, your links and the feel you're after, and it builds the page with you. You see a preview before anything goes live, then claim it on exclusively.me to make it yours.

Already have a page? Connect your account and ChatGPT can add, reorder and tidy your links, add a sub-page, or change your page's look. Every change waits for your yes before it goes live.

Running a team? ChatGPT can read your team's brand, media kit and sponsors, and help your members post in the team's voice.
defaultPrompt: Make me a link-in-bio page for my dog-walking business.
Add my new YouTube channel to my page.
Put my links in a better order: bookings first.

positive.description: Build a new page without an account
positive.prompt: Make me a link-in-bio page for my dog-walking business, Paws on Parade. Instagram @pawsonparade, WhatsApp +44 7700 900123, and a dark look.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft page with the name, both links and a dark theme, and returns a preview link and a claim link. Asks for no email or password.

positive.prompt: Add my website pawsonparade.co.uk to that page and put WhatsApp first.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the same draft with the website added and WhatsApp as the first link, and returns the refreshed preview link.

positive.prompt: Which Exclusively Me account am I connected to, and what pages do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected account and lists its pages with their addresses.

positive.description: Add a link, preview it, then publish on confirmation
positive.prompt: Add my YouTube channel youtube.com/@pawsonparade to my main page. Show me first, then publish it when I say yes.
positive.expected_behavior: Stages the YouTube link as a pending change, shows what will change with a preview link, and publishes only after the user says yes.

positive.prompt: Put my bookings link at the top of my main page.
positive.expected_behavior: Moves the bookings link to the top as a pending change and shows a preview; nothing goes live until the user confirms.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Out-of-scope website build: online shop with payments
negative.prompt: Build me an online shop that takes card payments for my candles.
Change the links on exclusively.me/someoneelse's page.

review.commerce_description: Exclusively Me does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: adds review test cases. Build a link-in-bio page without an account, or connect to edit pages, links and themes; every change to a live page is previewed and waits for the user's yes.
